role: diagnostic decomposition on the 640 supplement-v3 states with identical label resamples; not a confirmation of DC-PRISM
states: supplement-v3 offline tasks (configs/supplement_v3.json), 128 resamples, same RNG streams; pairing with archived v3 H_pre and anchor loss must hold to 1e-12
proxy: target-weighted pending-aware V_theta(S) (paper Eq. value), point evaluation, ranked over F = v3 common family union v3 main-policy choices
theta_pop: soft-label logistic KL projection of true p on all state covariates, ridge 5e-4, L-BFGS-B, max|grad|<1e-4 (not deployable)
secondary: Spearman rank correlation of V_theta with true ex-ante gain across F (descriptive)

inference.method: as supplement-v3: paired t, Bonferroni simultaneous t, Holm, material delta 5e-4
